title: Light Delightful Filipino Frankfurter Bao
description: Buttery, light, and satisfying Filipino-inspired bao featuring frankfurters and mantecare emulsion.

ingredients.name: Mantecare emulsion ingredients
ingredients.notes: Combine 1/4 cup vegetable oil and 1/4 cup water in a small bowl.

instructions: Preheat a steamer basket over boiling water.
Cut the bao dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on desired bao size.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk.
Place a few slices of scallions and a frankfurter in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling, pressing the edges to seal the bao.
Place the bao in the steamer basket, leaving space for even cooking.
Steam the bao for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the mantecare emulsion ingredients.
Brush the mantecare emulsion over the cooked bao before serving.
Drizzle with sesame oil and soy sauce to taste.
Sprinkle with salt and sugar to balance flavors.
